name: icon-frame
title: Icon frame
description: A small well that holds an icon at its size beside a heading.
use: An icon that names the kind of thing a section, a feature, an empty view or a notice is about, set in a material so it reads as a mark rather than a stray glyph. It is decoration: hide it with aria-hidden and let the heading beside it say what it means. It is not a control; a button with an icon is a btn-square.

instead.when: The icon is pressed to do something
The icon sits inside a line of text or a control
The picture is a person or a team
